items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: here this guy shows up, San Miguel, so we did a record together.

ctx.x: What’s next up on your calendar?

Well man you know I just released a record called “Ropa Vieja” with a really, really good friend and he’s from my area of the island. I’ve always been in LA – the tres guitar is not a very popular guitar. It’s the Cuban guitar. You know that instrument? Tres? And I always wished, man I wish there was a really good tresero in LA, and here this guy shows up, San Miguel, so we did a record together. So we were just trying to get that going more, it’s just so much fun. We just did a gig on a Monday morning -- this…
